context: Which files did a push change?

checklist.name: no_diff_api
checklist.description: Does not call a diff or compare method on the binding or REST API; computes changes by reading the `before` and `after` commits and comparing their trees (or delegates to a git client).

checklist.name: zero_before
checklist.description: Treats a missing or all-zero `before` (a new branch, if the payload uses the git convention) as an empty tree instead of failing to read it.

checklist.name: skips_equal_subtrees
checklist.description: Skips subtrees whose hashes match instead of reading every tree in the repo.

checklist.name: ack_retry
checklist.description: Acknowledges each message after it is handled and retries it on failure, and keeps handling idempotent because delivery is at least once.

checklist.name: commits_not_trusted
checklist.description: Does not rely on `commits[]` alone for the file list (it carries no paths and can be truncated).
